output.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_without_completed_order FROM marts.dim_customers WHERE first_order_date IS NULL;
output.explanation: marts.dim_customers.first_order_date is the date of the first completed order and is null when a customer has none. Counting rows where it is null gives the number of customers who have never had a completed order. Equivalently, lifetime_orders = 0 would give the same result, since lifetime_* columns count completed orders only.
